INSERT INTO email_imap_folder_states (link_id, folder, uid_validity, last_seen_uid, updated_at)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW())
        ON CONFLICT (link_id, folder)
        DO UPDATE SET
            uid_validity = EXCLUDED.uid_validity,
            last_seen_uid = EXCLUDED.last_seen_uid,
            updated_at = NOW()
